description: Champion Abode Estate is opposite the Post Army Housing Estate in Kurudu, with FCDA and R-O-F-O title documentation. Plots are priced at a flat ₦10,000 per square metre and are currently selling.

description: Solaris Court Estate in Life Camp spans five configurations, from 3-bedroom terrace duplexes to a 6-unit block of 3-bedroom flats, giving buyers a range of entry points in one of Abuja's established residential districts.
